name: SwatchFanCard
job: A product card whose colour or material options fan out like paint swatches, with the product image tinting to match the hovered swatch
visitor_action: hover or focus a swatch to preview it, tap to pick on touch, arrow keys move between swatches
mobile: true mini-fan at 375: smaller chips with names printed up the strip, same tap-to-pick and arrow keys
motion: chips fan open from a pivot hidden behind the lip with staggered spring overshoot while the twine tightens; picking a chip springs it forward (larger, lifted, name set as display type) and the rest spread apart like an accordion; the photo frame tilts with the pick and its see-through tint crossfades (reduced-motion: fan shown open and static, no springs or crossfade)

checks.render: composition round 2: not shot by builder (QA sweep re-judges); eyeballed default + 375 worst in a live tab only
checks.craft: composition round 2: not self-scored (QA sweep re-judges)

art_direction: Paint counter: a taped, framed photo print on a bone counter top with a big fan of matte paint chips (face, eyelet, paper edge thickness, name as display type on the picked chip) pivoting from behind a paper lip and linked by a twine cord; photo tint is a see-through layer; no-image fallback is a painted wall panel with a roller stroke and paint dabs; Inter Tight self-hosted
